verdict.rationale: Mastra documents its own event-driven triggering. MCP events can be subscribed to with `.subscribe()`, each event can start a workflow run, and webhook or polling events can be routed into agent-thread notification signals. This is code-level subscription wiring rather than a user-facing rule definition system, and the evidence is a short blog announcement plus marketing copy. missing for 10: declarative rule/condition definitions for triggers, in-depth reference docs for event-trigger configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Each event can be used to start a workflow run
Subscribe to events using `.subscribe()` to handle each event as it arrives.
Subscribe agent threads to external resources and route webhook or polling events into notification signals.
